opening_annotation.professional_name: Gateway Expand into Warp Gate Pressure
opening_annotation.data_driven_name: Fast Warp Gate with Early Gas
opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Establish a fast expansion while teching to Warp Gate for early pressure.
supporting_facts: The opening has a high rate of first gas observed (100%) and first production observed (100%), indicating a fast gas and gateway start.
The opening has a very high rate of first upgrade observed (99.9%) and has_cyber (99.7%), showing a focus on Cybernetics Core and Warp Gate research.
The medoid key sequence shows a typical build order: Gateway, Gas, second Gas, second Gateway, Cybernetics Core, Warp Gate research, and then a combat unit from the Gateway.
